title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Thorbjornsen's Maiden PGA Win
items.text: Michael Thorbjornsen leads his first PGA Tour victory in his 65th start by holding off Xander Schauffele.

items.headline: Kuwaki leads Women’s British Open
items.text: Shiho Kuwaki of Japan leads her first major title by beating Esther Henseleit on the second playoff hole at the Women’s British Open.

items.headline: McIlroy Prioritizes Family
items.text: Rory McIlroy confirmed he leads't play again until the FedEx St. Jude Championship, prioritizing family and national open titles over other events.
